detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE pursuant to SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires continuous disclosure of changes in substantial shareholding by persons acquiring 5% or more. The filing indicates a change in control or threshold crossing by the named acquirer. Exact shareholding percentage acquired, valuation, and timeline for open offer (if triggered) require access to the full disclosure document.
